curator_title: The Wish on a Falling Star
opening:
I lowered my head and made a wish.
The wish came true.
But I cried.
solution:
My dad is an astronaut. He went on a mission, and I missed him terribly. That night, I looked up and saw a shooting star, so I immediately wished for my dad to come home early.
But I soon learned that the shooting star I saw was actually a spacecraft crashing into the atmosphere. My dad did come back to Earth earlier than expected, but he sacrificed his life because of it.
canonical_facts: The narrator's father was an astronaut.
The narrator saw what appeared to be a shooting star.
The narrator wished for their father to come home early.
The apparent shooting star was a crashing spacecraft.
The father returned to Earth earlier than expected.
